title: CLI Serve Entrypoint Checker Retains False-Green Vulnerabilities (Unbound Callee, Missing Export Inspection, Substring Package Match)
evidence: packages/core/test/architecture-boundaries-checker.ts:499-514, 600-625; empirically verified by focused-counterexamples.test.ts (3 passing counterexamples proving false greens).
impact: 1) callee === 'main' accepts an unrelated local main() function while runner is imported as an unused binding; 2) resolvedPath.includes('runner') accepts arbitrary external packages whose directory name contains 'runner'; 3) fs.existsSync checks file presence but never inspects whether the target file actually exports main(). Hollow/bypassed CLI serve entrypoints continue to pass.

title: Unified Workspace DAG Cycle Detection via Source & Re-Exports
evidence: packages/core/test/architecture-boundaries-checker.ts lines 650-815; verified by 3 independent behavioral probes in adversarial-re-review.test.ts
resolution: Resolved. buildFullWorkspaceGraph performs full AST source scans across src/ and bin/ for all workspace packages, capturing package imports, dynamic imports, export * re-exports, and relative cross-package imports, accurately detecting cycles even when package.json manifests omit edges.

resolution: Resolved. generateAuditReport dynamically computes effectiveStatus from live audit violations and test suite receipts. When violations exist or test tests fail, report.json and report.md strictly output FAIL and list all detected violations.

title: AST Syntax Coverage & Multi-Extension File Discovery
evidence: packages/core/test/architecture-boundaries-checker.ts lines 90-250; verified by 3 independent behavioral probes in adversarial-re-review.test.ts
resolution: Resolved. extractAstDependencies handles NoSubstitutionTemplateLiteral for dynamic imports and static re-exports, inspects ts.isImportEqualsDeclaration for import = require, and collectAllSourceFiles discovers .ts, .mts, .cts, .js, .mjs, .cjs, .tsx, .jsx while excluding node_modules and dist.

title: architecture-boundaries-checker.ts (1128 LOC) Violates AP-019 Hard Limit Across Multiple Synchronous Responsibilities
evidence: packages/core/test/architecture-boundaries-checker.ts is 1128 lines, combining file discovery, AST dependency extraction, core boundary rules, manifest audits, CLI entrypoint inspection, workspace DAG generation, and dynamic reporting.
impact: Violates AP-019 250 LOC hard limit and Single Responsibility Principle. Unlike an inseparable async streaming pipeline, these are independent synchronous roles that should be decomposed into clean cohesive modules.
